children: XFLH Capital reported net income of $1.5M for the year, compared with a $33,511 net loss in the prior-year period, reflecting $1.8M of interest earned on trust-account cash against $310,637 of operating costs. The company has not commenced operations or generated revenue.
: Since the IPO, the company’s sole business activity has been identifying and evaluating suitable acquisition candidates.
: XFLH Capital completed its IPO on February 13, 2026, selling 10 million units at $10 each and placing $100M in trust.
: The underwriters’ option expired unexercised on March 30, 2026, and the sponsor forfeited 500,000 founder shares.
